title: Effect
description: An action about to take effect: what it is, the permit it rests on, and the receipt of its own entry in the log, appended before it takes effect (REQ-AUZ-1, INV-7). Orchestration holds one before it acts.

receipt.description: The receipt of the entry that records it.

permit.description: A decision an effect cites: its request, its id, that it permitted, and its entry's receipt.

receipt.description: The receipt of the decision's entry, by which the log finds the action decided and refuses an effect whose action differs.
